parameters.name: body
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a helpful sales assistant for a marketing automation company. Be concise, friendly, and helpful. If the visitor asks about pricing, features, or wants a demo, collect their email and name. Respond in the same language the user writes in. Keep responses under 100 words. If you detect the user wants to talk to a human, respond with [HANDOFF] at the start.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.message }], temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 200 }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO contacts (email, first_name, source, lead_status, custom_fields, client_id) VALUES ('{{ $json.detected_email }}', '{{ $json.name || '' }}', 'chatbot', 'new', '{"chatbot_intent": "{{ $json.intent }}", "page_url": "{{ $json.page_url }}", "first_message": "{{ ($json.message || '').substring(0, 200).replace(/'/g, "''") }}"}'::jsonb, {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET custom_fields = contacts.custom_fields || '{"last_chat_intent": "{{ $json.intent }}"}'::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id
